newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shooting at south Lebanon Palestinian camp.
newsitem.headline: Shooting at south Lebanon Palestinian camp.

text.p: Shooting broke out on Wednesday in a Palestinian camp near the south Lebanon port city of Tyre after two men were hurt in fights between rival factions, security sources said.
The shooting continued for two hours in Bass camp at the southern entrance of Tyre but there was no immediate report of casualties, the sources said.

They were not able to identify the combatants but said the shooting followed fights with fists and knives at the camp on Tuesday evening between members of the Moslem fundamentalist Ansarollah (Supporter of God) and a pro-Syrian group named Sae'qa (Thunder).
Two Ansarollah members were slightly wounded in Tuesday's fighting, the sources said.
